title: Amazing! Bird Sounds From The Lyre Bird - David Attenborough  - BBC Wildlife
summary: A short BBC clip in which David Attenborough shows a lyrebird imitating sounds, including camera shutters, car alarms and chainsaws. It comes from the BBC natural history series Life on Earth.
why: Brought up whenever threads touch on mimicry, voice cloning or bird vocalization, and people say the ending is startling.

quote.text: The end of this BBC clip blew my mind the first time I saw it.
